facts.value: An application without a completed bachelor's degree is possible if at least 80% of the required credits in the bachelor's program have been completed at the time of application.
Proof of enrollment in the bachelor's program and a preliminary transcript that includes an average grade and all previously completed exams must be submitted by May 15.
The preliminary transcript must be issued by an authorized institution for grading.
Maximum ECTS Bachelor's: 180 ECTS, Minimum ECTS for application: 144 ECTS.
Maximum ECTS Bachelor's: 210 ECTS, Minimum ECTS for application: 168 ECTS.
Maximum ECTS Bachelor's: 240 ECTS, Minimum ECTS for application: 192 ECTS.
The bachelor's degree certificate must be submitted by the end of the first semester of the master's program to obtain final admission.
It is strongly recommended to complete all necessary bachelor's coursework in the summer semester preceding the master's program for a successful start.
An online application through the Uni Assist portal is sufficient even if you completed your bachelor's degree at a university outside Germany.
For applications to a higher semester, a request for credit transfer and a record of completed achievements must be submitted.
Application deadline for the higher semester is by January 15 or May 15.
Credits that are not listed on the transcript can be transferred if an application for transfer is submitted with the application.
The program is limited in admission for all semesters.
Application for the second or fourth semester is possible for the summer semester.
Application for the third semester is possible for the winter semester.
Enrollment in a higher semester can only occur if there are open study places available and the corresponding ECTS credits for transfer are available.
For up to 30 ECTS, the classification is into the 2nd semester.
For 31 to 60 ECTS, the classification is into the 3rd semester.
For 61 to 90 ECTS, the classification is into the 4th semester.
If there are more applications for the higher semester than available spots, a ranking will be created according to the valid selection regulations.
